name: Harahara Shichau! ~Oya ni wa Naisho no Kozukuri Seikatsu~ -Asagiri Shimai Hen-
original_name: はらハラしちゃう! ～親にはナイショの子作り性活～ －朝霧姉妹編－
source: Haruki and Kotoko become lovers on a fateful afternoon in a shinto shrine dyed by the glow of the evening sun. All is going well until the announcement of their parents' marriage. The father of Haruki would marry the mother of Kotoko making them stepsister and stepbrother in an instant. Now they are going to live together not as lovers but as siblings. What will happen to their relationship...
translation: 晴树与琴子在夕阳染红的神社中，于命运的午后成为恋人。一切本来顺利，直到双方父母宣布结婚。晴树的父亲将娶琴子的母亲，两人瞬间成为继兄妹。如今，他们要以兄妹而非恋人的身份同住。他们的关系会如何发展……
